notes.title: Version 1.1 is Here — Steam Cloud, Battle Menu & a New You!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Portal Wanderers![/p][p]We’ve been listening, tinkering, and occasionally yelling at the Steam decks and cloud saving — and now we’re excited to announce that Version 1.1 of Portal Fantasy is officially live![/p][p]This update brings two of the most requested features, a full makeover for your player character  and a host of fixes, optimisations, and quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p]Let's delve into more details[/p][p][/p][h1]Steam Cloud Save Support[/h1][p]You asked, we answered — your progress can now be saved in the cloud. Pick up where you left off, wherever you’re playing. By default, your progress is saved locally on your machine, but you can manually save it to the cloud and restore it whenever you need to.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Battle Status Menu[/h1][p]You want to see all your Porbles’ passives and active abilities during battle? Now you can! Just open the menu during combat and plan your next move with all the info at your fingertips. You can find what key to press to open it during battles, as it varies depending on the controller you are using.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/9d8042676f5e57b986889096afe84bd7363da53f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Player Character Glow-Up[/h1][p]We gave your character a full visual overhaul — sharper details, better animations, and even more charm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/0918d80f4471a63f6797aad22b08b24da108b99b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/fd163420861089f149fd22a2758d77eae76ec2f2.png"][/img][/p][p]Even better: you can now change your look anytime at the Mirror in the Enchatara Shop. Feeling like a whole new you? Just say hi to the mirror and refresh your style whenever you’d like. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/748e2b833196e41a6a76d48ab91c767edb6290a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And yes, you can now have more unique hair colours (yes, we did hear every time you requested them)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/866158d6a3412b96e0afc28b8635ec43bc28a933.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And Much More…[/p][p]We also squashed some pesky bugs, smoothed out rough edges, and added plenty of little quality-of-life improvements. [/p][p]One of them is something that occasionally has affected some of you. Floating platforms that decided to… float away into the void? They’ll now reset to their rightful place (just like moving boxes already do).[/p][p]Here is the full list of changes:   [/p][p] [b]Version 1.1.0[/b]   [/p][p][/p][h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p]- Tinkerer class trait fixed[/p][p]- Curse no longer bricks battles[/p][p]- Dragon cave rentering working[/p][p]- Aqua cove loatables all work now

[/p][h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][p]- Moving platforms would stop when spotted by an NPC and reactivate when opening a menu[/p][p]- Use of potions doesn't display wrong amounts[/p][p]- Issue with Dustwirl map solved[/p][p]- Valeria Prison guard, now spots you and sends you back to jail[/p][p]- Fixed 2 items' descriptions in the Undercity merchant[/p][p]- Fixed a lever message in Storm Keep so it doesn't repeat every time[/p][p]- Fixed an exit cave in  Aqua Cove[/p][p]- Fixed some names of corrupted porbles in Storm Keep[/p][p]- Fixed Statue in Sunless River (Generic quest items)[/p][p]- Fixed colliders in Undercity[/p][p]- Ravenna now despawns on Storm Keep after the cutscene happens[/p][p]- Improvement in Undercity prison colliders[/p][p]- Fixed quest for the Statue in Far Isles[/p][p]- Fixed collider in Far Isles[/p][p]- Skeletons in the Solar Temple fixed[/p][p]- Wrong asset in the mirror puzzle in the Solar temple fix[/p][p]- Fix in Rescue Mission quest that could affect some players  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2][p]- No longer able to dodge being spotted by opening a menu[/p][p]- Bats can no longer touch pushables[/p][p]- Improved the close button layering in some menus[/p][p]- Lever moved in the 3rd dungeon to avoid a visual issue[/p][p]- New Status icons in battles[/p][p]- Improved colliders in Dustwhirl[/p][p]- Improved colliders in Magic Mountain[/p][p]- Improved colliders in Storm Keep[/p][p]- Improved colliders in Sunless River[/p][p]- Fixed category for majesty stones in recipe list[/p][p]- 3rd dungeon rewards improved[/p][p]- Improved end of Side Search so the game doesn't feel like the main quest is over[/p][p]- Animikiig interaction now fixed if you have an Animikiig in your party[/p][p]- Golden Gorge NPC line optimisation[/p][p]- Improved the M1 stones locks after the porble is at M2

[/p][h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2][p]- New Battle Status menu[/p][p]- Ability to change look by using the mirror in Enchantara[/p][p]- Improved character look[/p][p]- Improved rewards of the quest Scientific Approach, to match the predicted player level[/p][p]- Different biomes in the quest log now have colours [/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p]
Thank you, as always, for all your feedback and support — you continue to help make Portal Fantasy better with every step. Go forth, try out the new features, and don’t forget to say hello to person in the mirror.[/p][p]See you in Pyli![/p][p]– The Portal Fantasy Team[/p]

- Reports of lag in some battles
- Player reports of battles freezing after a certain point (we are investigating what item , skill, porble is causing it)

If you have anything else we haven't spotted, please reach out to us in the Steam forum or just add Haron as friend (they live in Steam now) 
https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199527335829/

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
With this update, we had to make a hard decision. 
Our colouring system was causing some issues in some porbles and causing errors when players tried to evolve them.
We are working on fixing it, but it will take some days to have them all working as intended. So we opted for a bit more dramatic move. You should be able to evolve all porbles that can be evolved to Majesty 3 fine. But in the cases where the dyes would cause a problem, the dyes will be removed.
To make up for this, a [b]COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS[/b] which will include enough dyes to set your porbles back to being the living canvas you always wanted.

We are also aware of some areas that are causing some issues with quest progress, and we are fixing them (many already are in test stage) and will be pushed as soon as possible, hopefully tomorrow 

Here is the full list of this update log

Version 1.0.6



[h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Fixed an error when evolving to Majesty 3 with dyed porbles for some species that was causing errors and not allowing the evolutions. In those cases, the Porble will evolve but lose custom colours. [b](COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS)[/b]


[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Prevention of the Fusion UI from allowing you to place 1st level majesty stones when doing more advanced majesty evolutions in some altars.
- Some baddie battles with broken Porbles (black boxes) were fixed
- Image fixes in some porbles



[h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2]
- Moving platforms now pause when players open menus, avoiding void falls
- Cleaning of some dialogues (minor typos)

[h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2]

[hr][/hr]

Some of you portal wanderers might have met our NPCs during the demo. And we loved seeing how some of you loved their ... unusual personalities. And as much as we loved having them in a pixel art we always felt that was limiting how we could show them to you. So we remade their portraits in non-pixel. This allows more expression, detail, and personality, making every conversation just a little more memorable (plus we  have some extra plans for them in the future)

"[i]He may still lecture you, but now he's doing it in high definition.[/i]"



But the facelift is not limited to the NPCs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/a781985f65de3524b7ea8e131ebadf958127633a.jpg[/img]

And yes we are aware the main menu is the place you pass by to get to the juicy part of the game. But when you boot up the game tomorrow, you might just want to take a moment. Our updated main menu artwork is something we think is worthy to be admired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/426c3d86651082076f3afc833763e7dc6918a16e.jpg[/img]
[i]"Even before you press ‘New Game’, the adventure begins."[/i]

notes.title: Roadmap, Pricing, & Coromon x Portal Fantasy!
notes.notes:
Hello Portal Wanderers!

We are super excited for the launch next week. But before launch day arrives on the 16th, we’ve got some special info to share that will give you a glimpse into what lies beyond...


 [h1][b]The Portal Fantasy Roadmap[/b][/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/a0acccd335f8d37495518ccb2c4682c29060590d.jpg[/img]

These are our current plans for the journey ahead, from everything you’ll find right from the launch day to what’s coming in future updates. We don't want to provide just a static game but an adventure that keeps expanding with more stories, quests, and Porbles for you to discover.


Here’s a quick review of what we have planned:

[h3]Launch[/h3]
From day one, you’ll be able to dive into the rich world of Pyli Kingdom — meeting quirky NPCs, solving ancient puzzles, collecting and battling with your Porbles, and uncovering the darker corners of the realm. Enjoy this full-fledged adventure with your porbles, gear, and familiars. 

[h3]Stage 1 – Post-Launch Updates (Versions 1.x)[/h3]
We’ll be rolling out regular content updates labeled as v1.x, each bringing new features, areas, quests, and quality-of-life improvements. Think of this as expanding the foundation — more fun, more Porbles, and more world to explore.
With the shift to the game being offline, we had to push PvP for a bit later, but it will still be here. You now just have more time to perfect your team of porbles before facing other trainers

[h3]Stage 2 – Major Content Drop (Version 2.0)[/h3]
Then comes the big one. Version 2.0 will introduce entirely new areas to the game — The Outer Realms - mysterious news regions with brand new biomes full of fresh challenges, lore, and plenty of secrets. It’s the next chapter in your journey, and we can’t wait to reveal more when the time is right.

Everything you see here is already in motion, and we’ll continue to listen to your feedback as we build. We want Portal Fantasy to be a living, growing world for you to enjoy together with your Porbles.


[h1]Pricing[/h1]

Ok, now that we managed to earworm ourselves with Jessie J's song, let's talk about the game price. Some of you have asked about this, so it is time to announce it.

We are launching at $19.99, and we will have a 10% discount for the first 7 days. 
But we are also aware that not every country has the same spending power, so we carefully checked every country, and regional pricing may differ depending on where you are (always lower, never higher). 

But it's not a party if you don't bring a friend along, right? 



[h1]Coromon x Portal Fantasy[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6a5d378b1b6378c9d0aa99e956f019343dd50f6f.jpg[/img]

Coromon is joining us at our launch! You can acquire 2 pixel art creature-capture games for 15% off. And if you already have Coromon in your Library (I know I do), you can still receive the discount for Portal Fantasy by completing the bundle. 


We're counting down the days with you. See you on April 16th.

notes.title: Portal Fantasy is Launching April 16th!
notes.notes:
Greetings,  Portal Wanderers!

We have some important news to share regarding the launch of Portal Fantasy. After much consideration and in response to the awesome feedback from you guys and seeing many of the streamers who have showcased our game, we've decided to reschedule our launch date from April 3rd to April 16th.

[h2][b ]Why the Delay? [/b][/h2]

As gamers ourselves, one of our main goals has always been to make sure we are giving you the best gaming experience we can. Over the past year, your feedback has been crucial in highlighting what needed improvement. To ensure that every player, regardless of location, enjoys the best journey possible in the Kingdom of Pyli, we've decided to implement a significant enhancement: offline.

[h3]Transition to Offline Mode[/h3]
By shifting Portal Fantasy to an offline experience, we want to provide a consistent gameplay experience without the dependency on server and internet connectivity. This change ensures that all players can embark on their adventures without interruption and that you can play Portal Fantasy anywhere (looking at you, Steam Deck users). This should also improve load times due to the previous server dependency.

This will cause a delay in releasing PvP, so it won't be available straight at launch as that has to be online, and we need to make sure all works as intended. PvP is still on the roadmap coming soon!

These 2 others are some big improvements we've been keeping a secret, but we can give you a sneak peek, since we are delaying the launch.

[h3]Enhanced NPC Portraits [/h3]
Our beloved characters now come to life with richer, more detailed portraits, adding depth and personality to your interactions with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/d8a7d36aecf0896a52e87bd2b053f3ebe0f65589.jpg[/img]
[i]Doesn't Jeejee look much more expressive? And she is not the only one. Wait until you finally see Dar's face.[/i]


[h3]Improved Porble Growth Stats Display[/h3]
We've revamped the way Porble growth statistics are presented, offering clearer insights into your creatures' development and strengths as they level up and evolve.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/43bdccad0ff64d1e4f6912d5fb0bfe130d6caa75.jpg[/img]
[i]He might have a shy personality, but look at those shiny stats[/i]


[h2]Why Not Update Post-Launch?[/h2]

While we could have proceeded with the original launch date and introduced these and other improvements in subsequent updates, we know that you deserve the best experience from day one. Taking this additional time allows us to integrate these improvements and test them properly, making sure you get the best experience for the adventure that awaits you at launch and not a few days later.

We know that delays can be annoying and frustrating, and we sincerely believe this is the best choice. Your patience and support mean the world to us, and we're committed to making Portal Fantasy worth the wait, instead of rushing the launch. 

We can't wait for you to experience the world of Pyli on April 16th!

notes.title: Don't miss before it is gone
notes.notes:
Greeting Portal Wanderers!

It’s been an amazing ride over the past year with you guys playing the Portal Fantasy demo — and we’ve loved seeing so many of you jump in, explore the Kingdom of Pyli, capture creatures, and help shape the game’s development with your feedback. 💖

But in the same you dispel Porbles at the fusion altar, so we must dispel the demo before the full launch on the 3rd of April.
The demo will only be available until this weekend, as we begin final preparations for the full launch! If you haven’t played it yet, now’s your last chance to dive in and get a feel for the world before the portals close (for now).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/f0318677195849e93f47bc84325cf54cf17cf13a.gif[/img]

Will your progress be carried on to the full version? Great question! Over the past year, we’ve made significant improvements to game balance, quest progression, and overall consistency across the game. Because of these major changes, progress made in the demo won’t carry over to the full version as it would break the game for the majority of you. We know that’s a bummer for some — but it’s all in service of making Portal Fantasy the best it can be. 
We originally were hoping to be able to keep it but realized that with over 200.000 players it would be impossible to ensure every game would be perfect.

But wait! There’s good news. To thank everyone who supported us during the demo period, all demo players will receive a special Jellyfish Familiar when the full game launches! It’s our little way of saying: you were here from the beginning, and that means the world to us (and to JeeJee as well). 💙
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/9a4e6b86d0b81691a5c4df367d5d6b8d1df4dcd9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/9a4e6b86d0b81691a5c4df367d5d6b8d1df4dcd9.gif[/img][/url]
And if you have any redeem codes worry not, your Toadshoom suits and capybara can be redeemed again in the full version.

No Demo Next Week, But... Big Things Ahead!

Next week may feel a little quiet without the demo, but don’t worry — we’re not going anywhere. In fact, we’re gearing up to share something very exciting: our brand-new trailer and our roadmap for Portal Fantasy future updates. Stay tuned — it’s almost time to open the next set of portals and discover new porbles, quests and biomes. 🔮

Thanks for being part of the journey so far! You fuel us to create this game

notes.title: The uses of AI in Portal Fantasy
notes.notes:
Many games these days use AI or purchased pre-made assets from stores. And we are not here to judge anyone. There are many valid reasons for this (economical, time saving, etc).
 
The question is what about Portal Fantasy? Well in this magical world we have crafted for you we have [b]used no artificial intelligence[/b] or purchased assets at any point to craft this experience for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c90f13ba1e22d30f078f05b5e631e4fe7eff4068.gif[/img] 
We believe in the old-school magic of human creativity.  Each pixel is handcrafted with love, all assets are made by our artists and each note is composed for our melodies that'll have you humming for days.



And to top it all we are [strike]insane[/strike] demanding. So we made our own engine so have no limitations in terms of imagination. Just those random pesky bugs we occasionally find. But even those are temporary limitations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c8abd717e5604f3aeb1cafa7a4e7d38cac342428.png[/img]

Our team of talented artists, designers, musicians, and writers have been pouring their hearts and souls into every pixel, note, and word because we want you to feel the warmth of the creativity that went into making this game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/318545301643d7e99888584185d342eea4d074fc.png[/img]

We believe that Portal Fantasy should feel like it is crafted by human hands and fueled by human dreams. Or nightmares...depending on what we are producing.

We have heard you. Those pigeons in the town square? They are so much fun to run to them and make them fly. A childhood pleasure for many.
But what if we could make it bigger? 
Like a whole island of it. Well just speak to Granny and she will send you to Pigeon Island.  Where our dreams will be made real

Talking of optimizing, we carry on improving the game's performance. We have upgraded the game engine, so you will see that the game is much smoother when you move and does not stutter like it did in some of the busier map areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4ba584990bd07cbcdf927854961eb23824130221.gif[/img]

And since you can move so well, now you can hunt for more items all over the map. We have reduced the size of items that are in boxes, chests, bushes… well, basically everywhere.

This adds a bit more realistic perspective as it made no sense for berries to be as big as you. Also, stop stealing all the berries. The berry farmer is after you.


Another thing you all asked for was to understand better what kind of damage was being done in the battles. And it makes sense if we are building a strategic battle system. So now the damage is colour-coded, and has a written label identifying what kind it is and its source. Prettier and efficient.

notes.title: Charpup! I choose you
notes.notes:
Next week we will release our first demo and you know what that means? 
That's right! It's time the start your adventure (even if it is just a small taste of it) and start catching some porbles.
But in order to do that, you will need to get to JeeJee so she can help you with your starter Porble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/1b01029d25ae979f6dc0b38674c7e45976fec411.gif[/img]

As is the tradition in monster catching games you will be able to choose between 3 different porbles from different elements.

So let's meet them

[h2]Groobeet[/h2]

We start with our emotional turtle Porble from the Gaia Element

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/825b8e391b3bf72622cc3a1725e1e3f93c532def.gif[/img]

[b][i]Groobeet is a very emotional Porble, and cries at any sign of wickedness, no matter how small. It once started sobbing when a man ate pineapple on pizza.[/i][/b]

[h2]Axolil[/h2]

Then we have our solitary Axolil from the Water Element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c0f7aaf2c38e320718e1b1ee05783228bbe96663.gif[/img]

[b][i]Axolil hates others and isolates itself, making it difficult to find. It would happily go a day without eating if it meant it didn’t have to see anyone.[/i][/b]

[h2]Charpup[/h2]

And finally, we got our friendly but fiery Charpup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/b09aef24f2fedfe692a3c2156ff4d16fbee9f196.gif[/img]

[b][i]Along with its adorable appearance, Charpup can read. Its favorite genre is romance, but it also really enjoyed reading “The Lord of the Porbles”.[/i][/b]

[h2]You decide[/h2]

Now it's up to you to decide which one of the three will join you at the start of your adventure. Let us know in the comments which one you are planning on picking next week for our demo.

Portal on.

notes.title: How fabulous is your hair for dimensional travel?
notes.notes:
Picture this. You are about to start an epic adventure that will change not only your fate but the fate of the world. What is the first thing you need to take care of? That's right! Make sure you look fabulous. 

That is the case in Portal Fantasy.  Before you face the world and even think about catching your first porble you will have the chance to decide on how you look to the world using our [b]Character Creator [/b] system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/cecafe97208b6dc419360e8522aea0c3936ada77.gif[/img]

From head to toe, you can choose your favourite style. 
[list]
[*]Want to have red hair with pigtails and a gorgeous pink dress? We gotcha!
[*] Spiky dark hair to match your treasure-hunter suit? Right on it!
[*] The shiniest golden suit so people don't notice your balding grey hair? Done!
[/list]
The possibilities are so immense that it will be hard to bump into another player in the world that looks like you.
But if you are truly a fashion guru your work is not done yet. Time to visit the twins over at the [b]Enchantera Shop[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/b3096c5d2363f1252165ddce7e065119999b6bf4.gif[/img]

There you will have an impressive array of hats, capes and necklaces to truly show the world that you are the most stylish hero this universe has ever seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c2a7b52355fac1d6ff85925368929fd907289145.gif[/img]

With all of this you can create millions of combinations and create a unique look. Think how awesome your statue will look in the middle of the town square where people can admire your immense fashion style for generations. Well, that and how you saved them all...

notes.title: Why mod when you can create?
notes.notes:
Did you ever look at a game level and think [i]"Well that is a nice map, but if I was the one making it I would do this instead"[/i]?

In that case, we have something cool to show you. 
Presenting the [b]Architect[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6af76fc414b54da08729ae720de6235ebb83464f.gif[/img]

As an Architect you will be able to build your own levels for yourself, your friends, and other players to play. Although what we are about to show you is still a limited early version of it, we were way too excited to not reveal it already.
So keep in mind the following:
[list]
[*] Everything here is in development so it might change (and if it does it will be to improve it).
[*] Nothing has been sped up. It is all in real-time.
[*] This is real "gameplay" footage, not concept art or a scripted scene.
[/list]

If you decide to play as an Architect you will soon find out that building a world is not only fun but also fairly intuitive and easy. We are trying to make this into an experience that doesn't require any previous experience in game design and that you don't end up spending hours trying to get that stone corner to match the rest. 
In little more than 10 seconds you can build some stone cliffs with swamp lakes for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/322cf08cd4afaabc8068634fd7f4c25a730bbd9a.gif[/img]

Add some items like barrels and stones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/8b6cbb5b90b96ce7680e26e57a2c9248d331b85d.gif[/img]

And even create your ideal floor with our tilesets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/291a9db389e27d52d46b6581b14e5fcf3f9742fd.gif[/img]

And if you change your mind or want to make something different you can always move items, remove or flip them for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c57d3746b3812b8d42c35a95bc85fe97acd0abdc.gif[/img]

And this is just the beginning, we are working on so many options that we hope you will enjoy. From critters to NPCs, custom-made quests and so much more. We can't wait to see what you can create with it all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/89cb910158b62054ab246a555f9567704f677b0b.png[/img]

notes.title: Fuuuuuusion
notes.notes:
As you advance in the world of Portal Fantasy you will find harder enemies and challenges. But as a Hero, you will have your Porbles next to you, and with your guidance, they will keep leveling up and get stronger. 
But sometimes leveling alone isn't enough. That is where [b]Majesty[/b] comes into play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/fea75d451b5e65c6f6427f5ac47f48a2bd199c5c.jpg[/img]

Majesty is a ranking system. Most Porbles you will find will be at level 0 of Majestiy. But you can increase it with the help of the fusion room and some...sacrifices.

Following recipes that use other Porbles and materials you can harvest all over the world, you will be able to increase the Majesty of your Porbles. There are even rumors that with the right ingredients, some Porbles can obtain a new look. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/ccfca3962c2a7c95dae4895977267ccab6659541.gif[/img]

Fusion will be available to any Hero that reaches Valeria, but you will have to use it strategically because beyond paying the price of sacrificing Porbles and other ingredients the Fusion Room will have a cooldown period before a new use. You know to recharge all the magical and technonlogical energy.
